info.description: Query Honeycomb datasets directly from Grafana. Supports timeseries, table, and stat panels with full group-by / breakdown support, deep links into Honeycomb, and aggressive caching to stay within API rate limits.

apiUrl.label: API URL
apiUrl.description: Honeycomb API base URL. Use https://api.eu1.honeycomb.io for EU accounts.

team.label: Team
team.description: Honeycomb team slug used in deep links to ui.honeycomb.io.

environment.label: Environment
environment.description: Honeycomb environment name. Leave blank for Classic accounts.

timeWindowDays.label: Time Window (days)
timeWindowDays.description: Maximum query time window in days; longer ranges are clamped before sending to Honeycomb. 0 = unbounded.
